I can't calculate embedded emissions for this shipment because the CN code isn't in the factor table.

The supplier declares ferro-manganese under CN 7202 11 (>2% carbon). The table covers only CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. Under the ruleset, if the good CN code is missing or not in the table, no estimate is made. The China and 500 t details are not enough on their own, because the default SEE is selected jointly by CN code and country.

To proceed, the factor table would need a default SEE value for CN 7202 11 produced in China. Once that is supplied, the calculation is:

Embedded emissions = SEE (tCO2e/t) × 500 t

The result would then be rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
